title: An early resistance warning helped doctors change a woman’s antibiotic
summary: An early resistance warning from CMUH’s Intelligent Anti-Microbial System helped doctors change a 78-year-old woman’s antibiotic before she recovered.
account: A 78-year-old woman at China Medical University Hospital developed severe pneumonia during a prolonged admission. The hospital’s Intelligent Anti-Microbial System predicted within an hour that her Stenotrophomonas maltophilia isolate resisted ceftazidime and suggested levofloxacin. Clinicians changed the antibiotic. The hospital reported that she recovered and went home in late July 2022. The account concerns one patient. More than 100,000 platform uses and projected changes in hospital mortality concern the wider service, not 100,000 demonstrated recoveries.
purpose: Help clinicians select an effective antibiotic sooner by predicting resistance from routine mass spectra.
system: 智抗菌平台 / Intelligent Anti-Microbial System (i.A.M.S)
developer: China Medical University Hospital, Taichung (team of superintendent Der-Yang Cho 周德陽, Po-Ren Hsueh 薛博仁 of the Department of Laboratory Medicine, and Jiaxin Yu 游家鑫)
domain: Healthcare - clinical microbiology and antibiotic therapy
segment: Hospital laboratory AI (antibiotic-resistance prediction from MALDI-TOF spectra)
taxonomy_note: The AI's part was turnaround time, a resistance prediction in one hour instead of days.

ratings.reason: The treating hospital described timely treatment of a severe infection, followed by recovery and discharge. The account does not establish a counterfactual life saved.

ai_role.statement: The platform analyzed a bacterial mass spectrum to predict resistance and suggest an alternative antibiotic. Clinicians selected and administered treatment. The hospital attributes earlier selection to the system, but the available account cannot isolate its effect on survival.

evidence.citation: China Medical University Hospital, “78歲婦人感染超級細菌昏迷 ! AI質譜儀1小時找出有效抗生素 《智抗菌》平臺累積十萬人以上使用 刊登頂尖醫學期刊《Journal of Infection》,” October 31, 2022. Original treating-hospital account, patient narrative and figure captions.
evidence.title: 78歲婦人感染超級細菌昏迷 ! AI質譜儀1小時找出有效抗生素

evidence.citation: 中央社 (Central News Agency), 記者郝雪卿 (2022). 78歲婦人感染超級細菌命危 AI質譜儀輔助治療. CNA, Taichung, 26 October 2022, reporting the hospital's press conference and quoting superintendent 周德陽 and vice-superintendent 薛博仁.

evidence.citation: 自由健康網 (Liberty Times), 記者蔡淑媛 (2022). 7旬嬤感染超級細菌命危 AI預測有抗藥性趕緊換藥救命. Liberty Times, Taichung, 26 October 2022, quoting 周德陽 and 薛博仁.
evidence.title: 7旬嬤感染超級細菌命危 AI預測有抗藥性趕緊換藥救命

evidence.citation: Yu J, Lin HH, Tseng KH, Tien N, Hsueh PR, Cho DY (2023). Direct prediction of ceftazidime-resistant Stenotrophomonas maltophilia from routine MALDI-TOF mass spectra using machine learning. Journal of Infection 86(2): e58-e60, letter, online 9 September 2022, doi:10.1016/j.jinf.2022.09.005. All authors at China Medical University Hospital; the letter has no abstract, so its keywords are quoted.
evidence.title: Direct prediction of ceftazidime-resistant Stenotrophomonas maltophilia from routine MALDI-TOF mass spectra using machine learning

evidence.citation: China Medical University Hospital, 2022 Corporate Sustainability Report, 37, “預測抗藥細菌，醫療數位轉型.” The report identifies i.A.M.S and compares inpatient drug spending with the corresponding period of 2021.
evidence.title: 中國醫藥大學附設醫院 2022 永續報告書

produced_by: The hospital's own laboratory identifies isolates by MALDI-TOF, so a spectrum exists as soon as a culture grows
A machine-learning classifier trained on the hospital's spectra and susceptibility records for Stenotrophomonas maltophilia and ceftazidime, one of nine species the platform covers
The platform returns the resistance prediction and a suggested alternative to the treating team within an hour
must_hold: The organism and antibiotic are ones the model was trained for
Clinicians act on the prediction before the conventional susceptibility result arrives
An effective alternative antibiotic is available and tolerated by the patient

comparator.quote: 中國附醫驗醫學中心副院長薛博仁說，由於菌嗜麥芽窄食單胞菌抗藥性強，一般臨床檢驗抗藥性要2、3天，透過AI大數據分析細菌質譜儀圖譜，1小時能快速預測有抗藥性，準確率達92%，醫療團隊發現原先用藥有抗藥性，立刻換上無抗藥性的抗生素，1週後就肺部感染大幅好轉，之後順利拔管出院返家。
